== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[K-3PO (Kay-Threepio) (Japanese)|K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141198263/5euBezLm0Uu37dAeUYGbKQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 74248143.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c1027b66ccdac023038e8719a63e508edaeb534b1a5e9b5d4177a4f558d40a41</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
